name.description: Canonical brand name shown in the UI.

aliases.description: Lowercase substrings matched against the statement merchant string.

invoiceUrl.description: Public page to download this vendor's invoices. Generic billing page only — never an account-specific URL.

invoiceUrls.description: For vendors that bill through several portals (e.g. Google: Payments Center, Cloud, Ads, Workspace). Shown as one button each. Same rule as invoiceUrl — generic pages only, never an account-specific URL. Listed before invoiceUrl, which stays the fallback for tools reading a single link.

url.description: Generic invoice/billing page for that portal.
